desc: Derive per-index feasible interval for u_i given H: lo_i = max(0, H − D_i), hi_i = min(U_i, H); infeasible if lo_i > hi_i.
Forward pass design: cur = [lo_1, hi_1]; intersect [lo_i, hi_i] with [cur.lo − X, cur.hi + X]; empty ⇒ infeasible. Forward-only suffices since reachable set is always an interval.

Monotonicity proof: if H feasible with sequence u_i, then for H' < H, u_i' = max(0, u_i − (H−H')) is feasible for H' (1-Lipschitz map preserves adjacency constraint, bounds hold). Binary search valid.
Answer formula: cost = Σ(U_i + D_i) − N·H_max; use Python ints (no overflow concern).
Implement final Python solution (sys.stdin.buffer, O(N) check, binary search over [0, min(U_i+D_i)]) and verify against samples 1–4 plus random brute-force comparison for small N.
